statement: Subclass quest from Species at Desert Dunes (3rd W2 map) lets each character pick a subclass.
Warrior can become barbarian or squire.
Archer can become bowman or hunter.
Mage can become shaman or wizard.
Recommends selecting one of each subclass to start.
Prioritize Shaman Barbarian and Bowman first since they specialize in world 2 skills.
Barbarian specializes in fishing.
Shaman specializes in alchemy.
Bowman specializes in catching.
Need the other three subclasses for world 3 skills so prioritize them right after the W2 ones.
Do bubble unlock attempts only on your Shaman thanks to the Bubble Breakthrough talent.
Bubble Breakthrough talent increases odds when unlocking new bubbles.
Prioritize orange and green cauldrons first for FMJ and Shacky bubbles.
FMJ and Shacky mostly help with defense and accuracy problems.
Buy more vial attempts in the gem shop and alchemy to ease vial unlocking.
Hold shift and left click to drop stacks of the item one by one; vial rolls go crazy and raise chances.
Technique also helps with epic gamer moments if you unlock that upgrade.
FMJ and Shacky are two of the most important early bubbles to level.
FMJ needs fruit flies to level up.
Shacky needs bloos (blobfish?) to level up.
Fruit flies are caught in the world 2 moonman map.
Bloos are best caught fishing in the last pool on the second fishing map.
Spend a decent amount of time farming these resources; makes progress easier and is necessary for late game pushing.
Buy Golden Sculpture Tool in W2 shop and drop it in front of the Statue NPC in W1 to turn him gold.
Gold statue NPC makes all statues bought in the new tab work for every character.
Upgrading prioritizes highest level statue any character has; deposited lower-level statues are lost when upgrading to it.
Once upgraded you can deposit the statue on any character and shared levels apply to everyone.
Go to the two palm trees secret location at the crab cake map and click and hold on the secret map to reach Poppy the kangaroo mouse.
Poppy minigame gives fishing efficiency fishing exp defense cash accuracy total damage and AFK gains bonuses.
Unlocking Poppy should be a priority as it helps immensely especially with bloo farming.
Sand Castles fifth W2 map is a great XP spot active or AFK similar to walking sticks in W1.
Best active farming spot is moonmen.
Sand giants and moonmen drop materials not used for much so they sell for decent cash.
Ghosts from moonmen are needed for certain boss quests and a few crafting recipes.
Reaching level 30 in fishing unlocks Island Expeditions.
Trash Island unlocks a few new stamps new bribes for Mr Piggy Bank a star talent and a name tag.
Rando Island gives a personal random boss battle each week and raises rare drop rate from bosses.
Crystal Island spawns free giant crystal mobs daily giving free loot and huge XP.
Seasalt Island unlocks last four fish and gives massive fishing exp plus a few cards with great bonuses.
Shimmer Island gives free bonuses stacking for completing a task each week.
Put points into skill efficiency for the Shimmer bonuses.
Fractal Island gives bonuses for stacking nothing hours and chance at the nothing trophy; he has 120000 hours without a trophy.
Island Expeditions are a must for long-term progression so hitting level 30 fishing should be a priority.
Finishing the quest line is needed to start getting keys once a day.
Quest line is a grind with abysmal drop rates at early levels.
Skip the quest line by running the W2 Coliseum with daily-claimed tickets; chests can drop a key.
Skipping lets you rush to World 3 and unlock elite classes; can complete the quest line later.
Boss has a mechanic that can one shot you.
Top right and top left arms are most dangerous; kill them first.
Each arm defeated makes the remaining ones attack faster.
Use Barbarian with Axe Hurl talent aiming from the platform below since hitboxes don't move to chip the boss safely.
Run food to heal through flame attacks and ring attacks.
Cheese also works with other classes but focus on pushing W2 with the Barbarian anyway.
Get the three W2 party dungeon boss achievements for 10% total damage account-wide.
Ask a friend or guildmate to run you through the party dungeon.
Buy capless bags and silver antiques once a day from the NPC shop in Enroaching Forest Villa map in W1.
Capless bags craft googly eyes and silver antiques craft djet eyes; both needed to summon W2 mini bosses.
Stack these items early so you have plenty of summons ready when strong enough to farm Biggie Hours and King Doot.
